hotel.name: The Langham, New York, Fifth Avenue

verified_facts.text: The original architects of the building were Gwathmey Siegel.
verified_facts.excerpt: When Gwathmey Siegel — the original architects of The Langham, New York, Fifth Avenue — first drew up the building plans

verified_facts.text: Two large oil paintings by New York painter Alex Katz hang behind the front desk and are the first in a collection of original artworks displayed throughout the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Both are by famed New York painter Alex Katz, and are the first in what has become a collection of 10 original artworks displayed throughout the hotel.

verified_facts.text: The hotel was built as The Setai Fifth Avenue in 2010 and joined the Langham Hotels and Resorts collection in 2013.
verified_facts.excerpt: Originally built as The Setai Fifth Avenue back in 2010, the hotel became part of the Hong Kong-based Langham Hotels and Resorts collection in 2013

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a couple of blocks from the Empire State Building.
verified_facts.excerpt: Just a couple blocks from the Empire State Building

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites have DUXIANA mattresses and views of the New York City skyline.
verified_facts.excerpt: Featuring stunning views of the New York City skyline and exclusive DUXIANA mattresses designed to provide a better sleep

verified_facts.text: The Langham Club is on the 4th floor and overlooks Fifth Avenue.
verified_facts.excerpt: The new Langham Club, located on the 4th floor and overlooking Fifth Avenue

verified_facts.text: The Deluxe Room with Terrace has its own private terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: your own private terrace — a great spot for evening drinks or an al fresco celebration.

verified_facts.text: The Family Room has a large walk-in closet, an oversized marble-clad bathroom and floor-to-ceiling windows with views of Fifth Avenue and Midtown Manhattan.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax with your loved ones in our spacious Family Room, featuring a large walk-in closet, oversized marble-clad bathroom, and floor-to-ceiling windows with views of Fifth Avenue and Midtown Manhattan.

verified_facts.text: The Two-Bedroom Empire State Penthouses are decorated with Roche Bobois signature pieces, fabrics by Maison Lacroix and Paul Smith, and art by Alex Katz.
verified_facts.excerpt: decorated with Roche Bobois signature pieces, lush fabrics by designers Maison Lacroix and Paul Smith, and art by Alex Katz

verified_facts.text: The restaurant Ai Fiori serves French- and Italian Riviera-influenced cuisine on the hotel's second floor.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ai Fiori treats diners to elevated French- and Italian Riviera-influenced cuisine from its perch on the hotel’s second floor

verified_facts.text: The gym has Technogym equipment and weights, a stretching area and on-demand classes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Visit the gym for an array of Technogym equipment and weights, as well as an area for stretching and on-demand classes.

verified_facts.text: The one-bedroom suites have a washer and dryer, a kitchen with a full fridge, and Empire State Building views.
verified_facts.excerpt: all of which have a washer and dryer, extensive closet space, a kitchen (with a full fridge), an extra half-bathroom, and Empire State Building views

verified_facts.text: Bryant Park and Grand Central Station are several blocks north of the hotel, and Koreatown restaurants are just to the south.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bryant Park and Grand Central Station several blocks to the north, the Empire State Building and the restaurants of Koreatown just to the south

verified_facts.text: There is elevator access to all floors and multiple ADA rooms are available.
verified_facts.excerpt: There is elevator access to all floors, and multiple ADA rooms are available.
